text: 你们离开山谷底部，攀上连绵的岩石山丘，寻找能证明发现的实物证据。
忽然，你们一直跟踪的猎径上有东西移动。你倒吸一口气：一头有蹄野兽，黄褐色，像羚羊，却是你从未见过的模样。它头部两侧长着六只Y形角。如果能把这颗头带回文明世界，就没人能怀疑你们发现的重要性。
hexacorn闻到陌生气味，立刻转身沿猎径逃走。你们全队追了上去。几秒后，伯纳德被一根枯枝绊倒，重重摔在地上。
眼看追猎无望，其他人停下来扶伯纳德起身。他扭伤了脚踝，只要小心行动就不算太严重；不过他未必做得到。
“教授！看！”诺曼指向山脊上方。你惊讶地望过去：那里有巨大的毛茸茸猿人。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 621
text: In search of physical evidence of your discovery, your party leaves the floor of the valley and climbs into a series of rocky, wooded hills.

Suddenly something moves along the game trail you have been following. You take a gulp of air. It’s a hoofed beast, a tawny animal more like an antelope than anything else you’ve ever seen. But it has six Y-shaped horns sprouting along the sides of its head. If you brought this head back to civilization, no one could doubt the importance of your discovery.
At the first whiff of your unfamiliar scent, the hexacorn spins and breaks along the trail. Your group races in pursuit. Within seconds, Bernard trips over a dead branch and suffers a bad spill.
Seeing the chase is futile, the rest of you stop and help Bernard to rise. His ankle is sprained; nothing too serious if he takes it easy. But he may not be able to.
“Professor! Look!” Norman points up the ridge. You stare with astonishment: gigantic, hairy ape-men.
